searchText: I’m curious, whats the performance hit you are seeing? also flagging for <@689161464829050960> <@830368514225340436> We have optimizes state in revm, one hashmap access to get warming and insertion and BAL so we dont need to have multiple accesses for state, then for is warm and them insert to BAL. I meant % wise Dont have numbers btw solution I am proposing is best option if we want to optimize BAL, dont touch accounts if we know the call is going to fail. yeah, sounds good to me Yes while I agree with you, I'd still say, for now, until we don't have rough consensus over this topic apart from moving along with it, let's do so and keep the reording topic open. My feeling is that this shouldn't be changed with BALs anyway and is more a change to EIP-2929 or call semantics, but be its own EIP, e.g. Deferred Account Loading in CALL Family Opcodes. I would like to hear what other clients think, it should be small change to code that we already touches bcs of BAL. Yeah imo I think it comes down to consensus across clients if we can get this optimization with low complexity. We should bring this conversation outside this thread. > shouldn't be changed with BALs I believe the situation here is no different than "two phased gas validation" that BAL defines. IMO, this change could be bundled with BALs too. I prepared this PR to-be-discussed on ACD this week, potentially again in 2 weeks on acde for a final decission, but I would prefer to get to a decision rather soon. Pls let me know, <@126385519469789184> and <@429719902363058177>, if that's what you guys prefer: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/compare/master...nerolation:EIPs:toni/state-access I'd then put it on the agenda and we can discuss if we want to do this and if it would be a too-big deal to just to with BALs. I can def see the argument that we're touching those code paths anyway. Also, it's something that we can test quite isolated as there're already quite similar tests.
